incident-bot: PAGED: latency-spike-2026-04-16-02 | Elevated p95/p99 latency observed for /v1/chat in eu-central-1 at 2026-04-16T14:40:01Z
Riley M: acknowledging, I'm IC. Priya you're primary oncall next 30. @Priya S please take over after I triage the routing layer.
Priya S: oncall in 2m. quick check - are we seeing client-side retries amplifying?
Devon H: looking at gateway logs now. seeing bursty retries from a small IP block; also a concurrent GPU imbalance on pool-3.
ops-bot: Autoscaler scale_down prevented due to pending workloads; pool-3 GPU UTIL 96%.
Riley M: immediate mitigation suggestion: 1) rate-limit aggressive retrying prefixes at edge, 2) temporarily divert traffic to eu-west-1 for non-dedicated tenants, 3) apply per-tenant backoff on dedicated if feasible. Priya coordinate with Support for customer comms.
Priya S: copying a short support-ready paragraph for in-thread use: ```
We are currently investigating elevated latency for chat in eu-central-1. Engineers are applying mitigations to reduce retries and shift traffic; some requests may see delays or transient errors. We will update within 20 minutes.```
Kai T: For internal notifications, we should standardize a compact "Incident Snapshot" for slack threads and email digests. Draft below: ```
[INCIDENT SNAPSHOT] {{incident_id}} | {{region}} | {{sev}}
Started: {{start_time}}
Scope: {{affected_services}} / {{percent_customers_impacted}}
Immediate mitigation: {{short_action_list}}
Owner: {{primary_oncall}} ({{team}})
Next update: {{next_update_time}}
Customer blurb: {{one_line_customer_snippet}}
Links: {{status_url}} | {{runbook}} | {{logs}}
```
Devon H: +1. also include a quick severity guideline: sev1 = outage (customers blocked), sev2 = degraded critical paths (>20% customers affected), sev3 = minor performance. Keep that in the template comments.
Priya S: customer tone guidance suggestion: open with apology, then simple impact line, then what we're doing, then ask for request IDs or timestamps if they hit issues. Avoid acronyms. Example short customer line: ```We9re sorry 56 you may experience increased latency for chat in eu-central-1. We9re applying mitigations and will follow up by {{next_update_time}}. If you9re seeing errors, please send request IDs and region so we can investigate.```
Riley M: For status page we need a 1-sentence public line + a rolling timeline. Public: "Investigating increased latency for chat in eu-central-1; mitigations in progress." timeline items should be time-stamped.
Priya S: Support kit idea: attach 1) 1-line public blurb, 2) 1-paragraph customer email template, 3) copyable diagnostics ask (request IDs, region, sample payload), and 4) status page link. I'll assemble.
Devon H: Routing update: started diverting non-dedicated traffic to eu-west-1, error rate for non-dedicated dropped from 3.1% to 0.4%. Dedicated tenants still impacted due to pinned capacity.
Kai T: Template variant for enterprise customers (more formal, include SLAs & next steps). Draft: ```
Subject: Incident {{incident_id}} - Performance Degradation in eu-central-1

Hi {{customer_name}},

We9re sorry to inform you of a performance degradation affecting chat requests in eu-central-1 beginning at {{start_time}}. Our engineers are limiting retries and redirecting non-pinned traffic to alternate capacity. For dedicated instances, we are prioritizing scaling and shard rebalancing. Expected next update: {{next_update_time}}. For urgent impact, reply with sample request IDs and account ID and we will escalate.

Regards,
Redwood Inference Support
```
Riley M: Good. Let's also add an "internal escalation note" template for SRE leads to use when looped in: ```
Hi {{sre_lead}},

Incident {{incident_id}} in {{region}}: elevated p99 for /v1/chat. Actions tried: edge rate-limit, divert non-dedicated, attempted scale. Current blockers: GPU pool hot, some tenants pinned. Requesting assistance with fast-rebalance or emergency capacity in {{region}}.

Thanks,
{{primary_oncall}}```
Devon H: We should commit these templates to the incidents repo under comms/templates with clear examples for short/long/public/internal. Also add a small checklist for handoff: - confirm primary mitigation in place - confirm status page published - confirm support kit posted - attach account list for impacted tenants.
Priya S: Handoff: I'm taking ownership for next 30m. Handoff checklist: I confirm routing diversion applied, support kit ready, status draft published (https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/{{incident_id}}), will push customer emails if Account team requests.
ops-bot: Mitigation note: emergency +1 GPU queued, expected available in ~3m.
Priya S: Published short public status update. copy: "We are investigating increased latency for chat in eu-central-1 and are applying mitigations. Some customers may see delays. Next update in 20 minutes."
Kai T: Post-incident change proposal: create a small comms linter that checks public/customer text for required sections (apology, impact, action, next update) and flags internal-only language. Might be a follow-up RFC.
Riley M: Action items: Kai -> add snapshot + templates to repo; Priya -> finalize support kit & publish to #support-alerts; Devon -> collect list of affected dedicated tenants and logs link; Ops -> confirm scaling outcome. File docs PR referencing this thread after incident closes.
Priya S: noted. filing PR for templates after incident: https://github.com/redwood-inference/incidents/pull/567
Devon H: Dedicated tenants list posted to the shared drive and tagged in #support-alerts.
Riley M: Excellent. We'll reconvene if we see regression. Closing incident thread for now, re-open if needed.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED logged for INCIDENT-ID-2026-04-16-02 by Riley M at 2026-04-16T15:05:00Z
